text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: It has been one night after the pre-party had ended, and it was finally the day of the Snake Festival. Medusa was walking alone in the residential area early in the morning.
text_block_list.orig_text:
前夜祭から一夜明け、
いよいよ蛇祭り当日──
早朝の居住区をメドゥーサが一人で歩いていた。

text_block_list.name: Medusa
text_block_list.text: ...Finally, this day has arrived, hasn't it? Sisters, I'll do it. I will defeat Nephy Nella and save you both no matter what.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ついに、
この日が来たのね。
お姉ちゃん、
アタシやるわ。
ネフィ＝ネラを倒して、
必ず助けてみせるからね。

text_block_list.name: Monika
text_block_list.text: Oh, what's up Medusa, you're up pretty early. The Snake Festival starts this afternoon, right? From the looks of it, you were too nervous to sleep.
text_block_list.orig_text:
お、
なんだメドゥーサ、
ずいぶん早いじゃないか。
蛇祭りは午後からだろう？
その様子だと、
どうやら緊張で眠れなかったみたいだな。

text_block_list.name: Medusa
text_block_list.text: Huh? Th-There's no way that's true... I just woke up early because I was too excited at my upcoming victory!
text_block_list.orig_text:
はあ？　
そ、
そんなわけないっての……
楽しみすぎて早く目が覚めちゃっただけなんだから！

text_block_list.name: Monika
text_block_list.text: Is that so? The participants that I've seen all over are certainly strong, but you've also got some bundle of strength within you, right? You don't have to rush. Just go up there and show everyone what you're made of.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうなのか。
参加者たちは
どいつもこいつも強者揃いだが、
其方も十分に強いのだろう？
焦らずに
いつもの実力を発揮すればいい。

text_block_list.name: Medusa
text_block_list.text: Like I said already, I’m not nervous! I mean, it's basically already a fact that I'll be the winner. All I'm looking forward to right now is facing Nephy Nella.
text_block_list.orig_text:
だから緊張なんかしてないってば！
だって、
アタシが優勝するのは確定してるんだから。
アタシが見ているのはその先、
ネフィ＝ネラのことだけよ。

text_block_list.name: Monika
text_block_list.text: ...I see. Saren and {0} are already back in Landosol, so they won't be able to watch, but I'll share their support for you in their place!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
そうか。
サレンたちは
ランドソルに戻っていて観戦できないが、
代わりに私が
あいつらの分も応援してやるからな！

text_block_list.name: Medusa
text_block_list.text: It's not like I need your or their support in the first place, but... Well, I do owe you three for helping me out a little, so I'll show you how I can win spectacularly.
text_block_list.orig_text:
別に応援なんて必要ないけど……
まあ、
アンタにはちょっとだけ世話になったし、
アタシが華々しく勝ち上がる様を
見せてあげるわ。

text_block_list.name: Miia
text_block_list.text: Aaah! Monika! This is terrible! Terrible, I say!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あぁ！　
モニカさ～ん！
大変、
大変です～！

text_block_list.name: Monika
text_block_list.text: Mia...? What's wrong, why are you sliding over here in a hurry... don't tell me the Snake Festival participants are causing a ruckus or something?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ミーア？　
どうしたんだそんなに慌てて……
まさか
蛇祭りの参加者が暴れてるんじゃないだろうな？

text_block_list.name: Miia
text_block_list.text: No, it'd be the opposite of that actually~ All the participants ARE GONE!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いえ、
その逆です～
参加者が全員、
いなくなっちゃったんです！

text_block_list.name: Monika
text_block_list.text: A-ALL OF THEM?! If it was just one or two, it'd be okay but... all of them without warning? That's unbelievable...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぜ、
全員！？　
一人二人ならいざ知らず
全員だと？
にわかには信じられないが……

text_block_list.name: Miia
text_block_list.text: I-I know right~... everyone came here from all over Gio Gehenna because they thought they were the best snake, so I couldn't imagine any of them quitting right before the event~
text_block_list.orig_text:
で、
ですよね～……
みなさん我こそはと
ジオ・ゲヘナ全土から
やってきた人たちばかりですから、
直前でやめるなんて考えられません～

text_block_list.name: Monika
text_block_list.text: With such arguments in mind, where could they have gone? Even speculating it to be a kidnapping, it'd be probably impossible to take all the partecipants out in one go. Has anything suspicious happened?
text_block_list.orig_text:
だとすると、
彼らは一体
どこへ行ったんだ？
誘拐の線も考えられるが、
強者ぞろいの参加者を
全員連れて行くのは
まず無理だろう。
何か
怪しい点はないのか？

text_block_list.name: Staff 1
text_block_list.text: Hmm, there are traces of banquets in the Colosseum, but there were no signs of fighting.
text_block_list.orig_text:
んー、
コロッセオには
宴会の跡は残ってるけど、
あ、
争った形跡は
なかったんだな。

text_block_list.name: Staff 2
text_block_list.text: First of all, it's not normal for a bunch of hot-blooded Gio Gehenna guys to be taken without a fight.
text_block_list.orig_text:
第一、
血の気の多いジオ・ゲヘナの奴らが
無抵抗で連れてかれるなんて、
普通ならありえないぜ。

text_block_list.name: Staff 1
text_block_list.text: Oh, speaking of suspicious, I heard that a flute was heard playing in the middle of the night. None of us prepared a flute or anything resembling it for the pre-party, so if you're asking for suspicious stuff, then that might be it...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
怪しいといえば、
夜中
笛の音が聞こえたって聞いたんだな。
前夜祭で笛なんか用意してないから、
怪しいといえば
怪しいんだな……

text_block_list.name: Miia
text_block_list.text: Right, right, there are also stories of people hearing a woman laughing loudly in the middle of the night. I didn't notice it last night because I was sleeping with earplugs in... But I wonder whatever that could be, maybe a new type of monster or something?
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうそう、
同じく夜中に女の高笑いが聞こえたって話もありますね。
私は
昨日は耳栓をして寝ていたので気付かなかったんですが……
でもなんでしょう、
新手の魔物か何かでしょうか～？

text_block_list.name: Medusa
text_block_list.text: Laughing loudly... I see. You too, Monika?
text_block_list.orig_text:
高笑い……
ねえ、
モニカ？

text_block_list.name: Monika
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I was thinking the same thing. ...That exhibitionist girl from the other day is suspicious.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ、
私も同じことを考えた。
……先日の
あの露出狂が怪しいな。

text_block_list.name: Miia
text_block_list.text: An exhibitionist girl you say... are you referring to Kanon, by chance? Well, she's sure skilled in a fight, but I find it impossible to believe she'd beat all the participants...
text_block_list.orig_text:
露出狂
って……
もしかして
カノンさんのことですか～？
いやでも、
あの人も腕は立ちますが
参加者全員を相手に勝てるとは……

text_block_list.name: Knights of the Royal Palace
text_block_list.text: Lady Monika! We know where the missing participants are!
text_block_list.orig_text:
モニカ殿ー！　
消えた参加者たちの行方が分かりましたぞー！

text_block_list.name: Monika
text_block_list.text: Wow! Impressive speed, Knights of NIGHTMARE! So where are they located at?
text_block_list.orig_text:
おお！　
さすがは【王宮騎士団（NIGHTMARE）】！
それで
彼らはどこへ？

text_block_list.name: Knights of the Royal Palace
text_block_list.text: W-Well... It appears that they are heading for Landosol.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そ、
それが……
どうやらランドソルに向かったらしいであります。

text_block_list.name: Monika
text_block_list.text: What...? Are you really speaking the truth!?
text_block_list.orig_text:
なに……？　
それは本当なのか！？

text_block_list.name: Knights of the Royal Palace
text_block_list.text: Yes. According to reports from multiple witnesses, the snake monstress silently headed toward the gate to Landosol, guided by a giant snake!
text_block_list.orig_text:
はい。
複数の目撃者からの情報によると、
蛇の妖魔人たちは
無言で
巨大な蛇に導かれるように
ランドソルへのゲートへ
向かっていった模様であります！

text_block_list.name: Knights of the Royal Palace
text_block_list.text: There were also testimonies of people hearing eerie whistling sounds and silly loud laughter coming from the group!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そしてその一団からは、
不気味な笛の音と
バカみたいな高笑いが
聞こえていたという証言も！

text_block_list.name: Medusa
text_block_list.text: ...Ah! That settles it. That damn Kanon said she'd defeat Nephy Nella, so why is she heading to Landosol now?! It doesn't make sense!
text_block_list.orig_text:
っ！　
これで決まりじゃない。
カノンのやつ、
打倒ネフィ＝ネラとか言ってたくせに
なんでランドソルに行くのよ！　
意味分かんない！

text_block_list.name: Miia
text_block_list.text: Whatever the reason, knowing that girl, she's clearly up to no good~ Aaah, geez! If only the Princess was here to deal with things at a time like this~!
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんにしろ、
あの人のことですから
ロクでもないことは確かですね～
ああもう！　
こんな時に媛さまがいてくれたら～！

text_block_list.name: Monika
text_block_list.text: There's no point in crying over spilled milk. I will return to Landosol immediately! In the future we'll have to crack down on unauthorized use of the Gate... Of course, I will definitely get everyone back, so prepare for the Snake Festival and wait for me.
text_block_list.orig_text:
嘆いたところで仕方ない。
私は
すぐにでもランドソルに戻る！
ゲートの無断使用は
厳重に取り締まらなくてはならんし……
もちろん
必ず皆を取り戻すから、
蛇祭りの準備をして待っていてくれ。

text_block_list.name: Miia
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes! The Snake Festival is one of the main attractions of this Cultural Exchange Festival! We won't allow it to be cancelled!
text_block_list.orig_text:
は、
はい！　
蛇祭りは交流祭の目玉の一つ、
絶対に中止になんかさせませんよ～！

text_block_list.name: Medusa
text_block_list.text: Monika. Take me with you to Landosol!
text_block_list.orig_text:
モニカ、
アタシもランドソルに連れてって。

text_block_list.name: Monika
text_block_list.text: Medusa, you...
text_block_list.orig_text:
メドゥーサ、
おまえ……

text_block_list.name: Medusa
text_block_list.text: Don't even think about stopping me. She ruined the Snake Festival... Now that it's come to this, I won't be satisfied until I give that stupid bat-woman a good smacking!
text_block_list.orig_text:
止めないでよ。
蛇祭りを台無しにしてくれちゃって……
こうなったら
あのフザけた蝙蝠女に
一発入れてやんないと気が済まないわ！

text_block_list.name: Monika
text_block_list.text: Heh, I wasn't planning to stop you! But make sure not to get yourself hurt in the process. You're still planning to win the Snake Festival, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふっ、
止めやしないさ！　
ただし、
ケガはするなよ。
蛇祭りで優勝するのだろう？

text_block_list.name: Medusa
text_block_list.text: Of course I am! This is merely the perfect occasion for me to warm up before the festival. Come on now, to Landosol!
text_block_list.orig_text:
もちろんよ！　
祭りの前のウォーミングアップに丁度いいわ。
さあ行くわよ、
ランドソルへ！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Around the time Monika and Medusa headed for Landosol, the snake army led by Kanon reached the city of Landosol and began to attack.
text_block_list.orig_text:
モニカとメドゥーサがランドソルへ向かう頃、
カノン率いる蛇の軍団はランドソルの街中へと到達、
進攻していた。

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Z-Zzz, zzz...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ズ、
ズズズ、
ズズ……

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Zazazaza...
text_block_list.orig_text: ザッザッザッ……

text_block_list.name: Resident who's randomly there
text_block_list.text: W-WHAAAAAAT?! T-There's a big snake in the middle of the city?! And are those people behind it from Gio Gehenna?
text_block_list.orig_text:
え、
えええ！　
お、
おっきな蛇が街中に……！？
それに
後ろの人たちって、
ジオ・ゲヘナの人？

text_block_list.name: Tourist who's randomly there
text_block_list.text: Huh? Why are those snake monstress here in Landosol? Ah, maybe they're hosting the Snake Festival here too! I didn't think I'd be able to see it while I was traveling, so that's lucky!
text_block_list.orig_name: 偶然居合わせた観光客
text_block_list.orig_text:
あれ？　
なんで蛇の奴らがランドソルにいるんだ？
あ、
もしかして
こっちでも蛇祭りやるってことか！
旅行中で見れないと思ったからラッキーだぜ！

text_block_list.name: NIGHTMARE Captain
text_block_list.text: STOOOOOOP! You all... you're from Gio Gehenna, aren't you? I've heard about our mutual Exchange Festival, but you haven't been granted permission to hold such a large-scale event in this world!
text_block_list.orig_text:
止まれー！　
お前たち、
ジオ・ゲヘナの者だな？
交流祭のことは聞いているが、
このような大規模な催しは許可が下りていないぞ！

text_block_list.name: Kanon
text_block_list.text: *sigh* I believe you've got it all wrong. This is, of course, the coronation parade for this country's new princess! As if I'd need any permission. OOOH HO HO HO!
text_block_list.orig_text:
はぁ、
勘違いも甚だしいですわね。
これはそう、
この国の新たな王女の戴冠パレード！
許可を取る必要なんてありませんコトよ。
ヲ～
ッホッホ！

text_block_list.name: NIGHTMARE Captain
text_block_list.text: Khhh, hearing such things from a delusional exhibitionist is degrading...! We really should have just caught you right there the other day. Anyway, turn back now! Or else...
text_block_list.orig_text:
くっ、
妄想狂の露出狂とは度し難い……！
やはり先日
意地でも捕まえておくべきだったな。
ともかく今すぐ引き返せ！　
さもなくば……

text_block_list.name: Kanon
text_block_list.text: My! You're quite passionate about your work etiquette right at the start of the new year. As soon as I inherit this country, I'll make sure to give you lots of work as a slave.
text_block_list.orig_text:
まあ、
新年早々お仕事熱心ですこと。
あたくし様がこの国を頂戴したあかつきには
家来としてコキ使って差し上げますわ。

text_block_list.name: Kanon
text_block_list.text: HO-WE-VER... the crime of turning your blade against me is by no means light. You will pay with your own body. Now, listen to your heart's content! The majestic melody of my "Snake Manipulation"!
text_block_list.orig_text:
で・
す・
が、
あたくしに刃を向けた罪、
決して軽くはありません。
その身をもって
しっかり償っていただきますわ。
さあ、
存分にお聴きなさい！　
荘厳なる蛇操の調べを！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: And a little later after Kanon had arrived, Monika and Medusa also returned safely to Landosol.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そしてカノンに遅れることしばし、
モニカとメドゥーサもランドソルへと帰還を果たす。

text_block_list.name: Monika
text_block_list.text: Ugh, we've fallen quite behind her tracks...! From what I can see, we're lucky that it hasn't become a big mess just yet. But we don't have much time! Let's hurry, Medu--
text_block_list.orig_text:
くっ、
だいぶ後れを取ってしまったが……！
見たところ
まだ大きな混乱にはなっていないのはラッキーだったな。
だが
猶予はない！　
急ごう、
メドゥ──

text_block_list.name: Medusa
text_block_list.text: Ah, kh... Ugh...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
く……
うぅ……

text_block_list.name: Monika
text_block_list.text: Medusa?! What's wrong? Does it hurt somewhere?! There doesn't seem to be an injury...
text_block_list.orig_text:
メドゥーサ！？　
どうした、
どこか痛むのか！？
ケガではないようだが……

text_block_list.name: Medusa
text_block_list.text: That's not it, there's a very nasty sound... Ugh, my head hurts...
text_block_list.orig_text:
違う、
すごくイヤな音が……
うっ、
頭が、
痛い……

text_block_list.name: Monika
text_block_list.text: A sound? Now that she mentions it, I can hear a faint sound like a flute whistle...
text_block_list.orig_text:
音？　
言われてみれば、
かすかな笛のような音が……

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Ohhhh... Ohh...
text_block_list.orig_text: ォォオオ……オォ……

text_block_list.name: Monika
text_block_list.text: What was that just now...? The ground rumbled... No... Maybe something happened. Medusa, can you move?
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんだ、
今のは……
地鳴り……
いや……
何か起きたのかもしれん。
メドゥーサ、
行けるか？

text_block_list.name: Medusa
text_block_list.text: Of course I can, y-you don't have... to worry about me. I'll definitely blow that exhibitionist bat-woman into the sky!
text_block_list.orig_text:
もちろん、
よ……
気遣いは無用、
必ずあの露出狂をぶっ飛ばすわよ！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: At the same time, at the Sarendia Orphanage, everyone had finished eating their New Year's dishes and was taking a break.
text_block_list.orig_text:
時を同じくしてサレンディア救護院では、
皆で正月料理を食べ終え一息ついていた──

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text: Phew, thanks for the meal. Gio Gehenna was a nice place, but home is still the most relaxing place to be at. It's been a long time since I've had such a relaxing time.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふぅ、
ごちそうさま。
ジオ・ゲヘナもいい所だったけど、
やっぱり我が家が一番落ち着くわね。
こんなにゆっくり過ごすの、
すごく久しぶりだわ。

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text: That said... you didn't really have to come back with me, {0}.
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも、
あんたまで一緒に戻ってこなくてもよかったのに。

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text: There's no need to be so dutiful, you know? But... thank you. The children are happy you're here.
text_block_list.orig_text:
別に
律儀に守ることじゃないのよ？
でも、
ありがとう。
子どもたちも
あんたが来てくれて
よろこんでるわ。

text_block_list.name: Orphanage Child 1
text_block_list.text: Mama Saren! Nii-chan! Thank you for the souvenir!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ママ・サレン！　
兄ちゃん！
おみやげありがとう！

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text: Haha, you're welcome. You all did a great job watching the house by yourself.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふ、
どういたしまして。
みんなもお留守番
頑張ったわね。

text_block_list.name: Orphanage Child 2
text_block_list.text: Hey, hey, you two, I want to go out to the city!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ねえねえ二人とも、
あたし街におでかけしたい！

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text: That's right. I'd also like to go and see what Landosol is like in the New Year. Well then, let's all go later.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうね、
ランドソルの新年の様子も
見に行きたいものね。
それじゃあ
後でみんなで行きましょう。

text_block_list.name: Orphanage Child 1
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaay! I really want to go see that Snake Festival!
text_block_list.orig_text:
やったー！　
オレ、
ヘビのお祭り行きたい！

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text: Hmm, sorry. But the Snake Festival is a festival that's held only in Gio Gehenna, so I don't think we'll be able to go see it just yet.
text_block_list.orig_text:
んー、
ごめんね、
蛇祭りはジオ・ゲヘナのお祭りだから、
今回はちょっと無理そうかな。

text_block_list.name: Orphanage Child 1
text_block_list.text: You're wrong, Mama Saren. There's also a Snake Festival here in Landosol.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちがうよ、
ママ・サレン。
ランドソルでやってる蛇祭りだよ。

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text: Huh? But, I didn't hear of any plans about holding it in Landosol...
text_block_list.orig_text:
え？　
でも、
ランドソルでそんなのやる予定なんて
ないんだけど……

text_block_list.name: Orphanage Child 2
text_block_list.text: I heard the same thing. A parade featuring a HUUUUUGE snake and snake-like people was seen heading towards the castle!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あたしも聞いたよ。
おーっきなヘビと、
ヘビみたいな人たちのパレードが、
お城に向かってったって！

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text: ...What's with that? By "snake-like people" you must mean the snake monstress, right? But why Landosol... and a huge snake...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……どういうこと？　
蛇みたいな人って、
ジオ・ゲヘナの
妖魔人よね？
どうして
ランドソルに……
それに
大きな蛇
って……

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text: I agree... Everyone, I have an urgent matter to attend to, so please wait at home. Let's hang out and play when I come back!
text_block_list.orig_text:
同感だわ……
みんな、
ちょっと急用ができたから
おうちで待ってて。
戻ってきたら
遊びに行きましょう！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Saren and {0} rushed to the city with anxiety in their hearts. There they found a scene on the brink of war...
text_block_list.orig_text:

そこで二人が目にしたのは一触即発の現場だった──

text_block_list.text: Th-This is...!

こ、
これは……！

わあ
